catalyst_observation.source_statement: Failed all three primary endpoints (ORR, PFS, OS) of the 783-patient PIVOT IO-001 trial. Triggered Bristol Myers Squibb to walk away from a collaboration worth up to $3.6B in milestones (on top of a $1.85B 2018 upfront), followed by sweeping Nektar layoffs. One of the most consequential biotech Phase 3 failures of 2022 per FierceBiotech's retrospective.
